req.title: Retrieve all players
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /players with a JSON array of all players in the database.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states GET /players/ must return HTTP 200 and a JSON array of all Player objects. I designed tests covering: (1) positive EP — database has 26 pre-loaded rows, verify exact count, status code 200, and Content-Type; (2) negative NEG — wrong HTTP method (POST without body) yields 4xx, not 200; (3) boundary BVA — verify the first and last player in the array match known fixture rows (squad numbers 1 and 26), catching off-by-one or truncation mutations; (4) DT — verify every required PlayerResponseModel field is present and correctly typed in each returned object; (5) STC — verify cache header transitions: first call is MISS, second call is HIT, confirming state-dependent behaviour in get_all_async. All assertions use exact values to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_all_players_returns_200_and_26_items():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get('/players/')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    body = response.json()
    assert isinstance(body, list)
    assert len(body) == 26
    assert 'application/json' in response.headers.get('content-type', '')

test_get_all_players_returns_200_and_26_items()

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
import uuid

def test_get_all_players_response_objects_have_required_fields():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get('/players/')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    players = response.json()
    assert len(players) == 26
    for p in players:
        assert 'id' in p
        assert 'firstName' in p
        assert 'lastName' in p
        assert 'squadNumber' in p
        assert 'position' in p
        assert isinstance(p['squadNumber'], int)
        assert isinstance(p['firstName'], str)
        assert len(p['firstName']) > 0
        assert isinstance(p['lastName'], str)
        assert len(p['lastName']) > 0
        uuid.UUID(p['id'])

test_get_all_players_response_objects_have_required_fields()

tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_all_players_boundary_first_and_last_squad_numbers():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get('/players/')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    players = response.json()
    by_squad = {p['squadNumber']: p for p in players}
    assert 1 in by_squad
    assert by_squad[1]['firstName'] == 'Anjali'
    assert by_squad[1]['lastName'] == 'Banerjee'
    assert 26 in by_squad
    assert by_squad[26]['firstName'] == 'Aditya'
    assert by_squad[26]['lastName'] == 'Mehta'
    assert 0 not in by_squad
    assert 27 not in by_squad

test_get_all_players_boundary_first_and_last_squad_numbers()

tests.name: test_get_all_players_cache_miss_then_hit
preconditions: Database is pre-loaded with exactly 26 player rows
In-memory cache is empty at test start (fresh TestClient)
actions: Send first GET /players/ — cache should be cold
Send second GET /players/ — cache should be warm
expected: First response: HTTP 200, X-Cache header equals 'MISS'
Second response: HTTP 200, X-Cache header equals 'HIT'
Both responses return exactly 26 players
trace: R-PLAYER-001: caching behaviour in get_all_async — state transition from MISS to HIT
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_all_players_cache_miss_then_hit():
    client = TestClient(app)
    r1 = client.get('/players/')
    assert r1.status_code == 200
    assert r1.headers.get('x-cache') == 'MISS'
    assert len(r1.json()) == 26
    r2 = client.get('/players/')
    assert r2.status_code == 200
    assert r2.headers.get('x-cache') == 'HIT'
    assert len(r2.json()) == 26

test_get_all_players_cache_miss_then_hit()

from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_all_players_exact_known_player_fields():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get('/players/')
    assert response.status_code == 200
    players = response.json()
    by_squad = {p['squadNumber']: p for p in players}
    p10 = by_squad[10]
    assert p10['firstName'] == 'Kabir'
    assert p10['middleName'] == 'Mary'
    assert p10['lastName'] == 'Reddy'
    assert p10['position'] == 'Right Winger'
    assert p10['team'] == 'River Plate'
    assert p10['league'] == 'Ligue 1'
    assert p10['starting11'] == False
    assert p10['id'] == 'e51a3744-b879-41cb-a100-533f9d5a0bc6'

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

def test_get_all_players_all_26_squad_numbers_present():
    client = TestClient(app)
    response = client.get('/players/')

    squad_numbers = {p['squadNumber'] for p in players}
    expected = set(range(1, 27))
